title: GitHub releases table schema and migration
description: Define the github_releases table for storing GitHub release records, including raw release notes and optional AI-generated summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: FK to projects.id with cascade delete
ai_summary nullable TEXT for optional AI changelog

steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/githubReleases.ts. Define github_releases: id (uuid pk), project_id (uuid notNull FK → projects cascade delete), tag_name (varchar 255 notNull), name (varchar 255 nullable), body (text nullable — raw GitHub release notes), ai_summary (text nullable — AI-generated summary), published_at (timestamp notNull), url (text notNull), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).
Add composite index on (project_id, published_at DESC) for timeline ordering.

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type GithubRelease and type NewGithubRelease. Add 'export * from ./githubReleases' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify github_releases table.

technicalNotes: tag_name (e.g., 'v1.0.0') is the release identifier from GitHub
ai_summary is populated later via the AI summarize endpoint — it starts as null
